test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 6 to 11. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '6'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1357f8748160f7b91188209dd8d0b0901a9b94d8de2f1e72f084d1284ae47673.png]
solution:
Here, we have two dices and both have two faces in common.

Given: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdeb4238a6bfc39d6bde45140e13898c7d07b016c61578c12636a74445a90122.png] 

So, we will rotate the 2nd dice in such a way that the common faces are in the same position as the 1st one.

Thus, we can say that face 9 is opposite to face 6.

Hence, the number '__**9**__' will be on the face opposite to the one showing '6'.
